svg.aria-label: Day 3 hero: a glowing globe in the middle with a burger, sushi, a music note, a streetwear hoodie, a paper lantern and a cup of coffee orbiting it. On the left, three students write one essay together on a shared laptop with coloured cursors. On the right, a presenter points to an eco-tourism slide for a seminar group. A feedback card with ticks floats at the top left and an AI chat bubble saying “Explain my rubric” floats at the top right; the essay question sits under the globe.

g.text: Is cultural globalisation having a negative impact on culture?
